Mainmatter (https://mainmatter.com/rust-consulting/) | REMOTE (EU) | Lead Rust Engineering Consultant | Full-time | 100–140k€

Mainmatter (https://mainmatter.com), the company behind EuroRust (https://eurorust.eu), is looking for an exceptional Rust engineering consultant to lead our team. You'll be supporting international clients like Google, BMW, and Redis in adopting Rust: reviewing their codebase, recommending and implementing improvements, driving codebase migrations to Rust, and training their team on advanced Rust concepts.

- Must be located in the EU - Excellent Rust skills, including several years of using Rust in a production environment - Excellent engineering skills, ideally 10+ years of professional experience - Excellent English communication skills

The ideal candidate has spoken at conferences, ran workshops, written articles etc.

See the full job description and contact information here: https://mainmatter.notion.site/Lead-Rust-Engineering-Consult...
